goal: 1:1 visual and behavioral parity between the Java Mindustry reference (../Mindustry) and the Godot client, proven by mirrored actions, screenshot diffs, and per-item reproduction chains. The ledger is also the coverage record: every interactive element and player action is an item, whether it matches or not.

focus.note: operator: start with everything after Play > Campaign (planet page and deeper); set to null to resume the global queue

java.window: 1152x648 windowed, UI scale 1.0, language en, volumes 0
java.launch: setsid env DISPLAY=:10 HOME=parity-java-home XDG_DATA_HOME=parity-java-home/.local/share XDG_CONFIG_HOME=parity-java-home/.config XDG_CACHE_HOME=parity-java-home/.cache /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/java -jar ../Mindustry/desktop/build/libs/Mindustry.jar

environment.notes: Both clients run concurrently on :10. Raise the Java window before capturing it (window_ctl.py raise Mindustry); the Godot game is captured through MCP.

status_notes.seeded: discovered or compiled from a chain; no fresh matched run yet
status_notes.verified: closed; evidence class in verified.mode (seed = one observation per leg in a seed sweep, chain = full path+steps re-run under the gate, reference = fresh Godot run gated against a stored Java reference frame)
status_notes.mismatch: a run stopped here with fresh artifacts from both legs (a seed sweep can open an item as mismatch directly)
status_notes.blocked: cannot be run (client will not launch, bridge down, ...); the failing tool call is recorded in mismatch or fix
status_notes.reference: Java-side reference evidence recorded by a soak (skill §2b); not a verdict — the Godot walk (verified.mode=reference, skill §3b) is still open

focus.role: Operator scope; wins over the default queue. kind=item runs that PAR-####; kind=area|path runs the first non-verified item whose surface/title/chain/parent lineage/path.to matches the target/path tokens, or seeds that area when none exist yet. Copy into run.json and bump updated when changed; null resumes the global queue.

hiccups.rule: The moment friction costs a retry (tool error, maximized window, blank capture, dropped input, stale binary, bridge drop), append a dated entry to computer-mcp-learnings.md (Java/X leg) or open-godot-mcp-learnings.md (Godot/bridge leg) with symptom, failing call, workaround, run dir — before continuing. The end-of-item step only verifies nothing was missed.

discovery.rule: No newly revealed interactive surface is left unrecorded: before leaving a fork (in a seed sweep or a normal item run), append one item per visible control/action with parent, surface, path and discovered_by.
discovery.seed_sweep: A bounded breadth-first walk over both live clients from the boot state; one surface per sweep. For each element: act once per leg, capture both, frame_diff under the gate. A match closes as verified.mode=seed; a divergence opens as mismatch with the exact calls. Sweeps never fix.
discovery.wait_for: operator request, seeding.last_sweep == null, or the frontier is non-empty and the ledger is thin

path.role: Fast-forward navigation to the item's fork. Replayed back-to-back once per leg in a single tool-call chain (one execute call per leg); never captured or diffed per step. Only the action under test is mirrored step by step.

fields.to: the fork state the item starts from (after this replay)
fields.java: ordered computer-mcp/shell calls to reach the fork
fields.godot: ordered godot_* calls to reach the fork
fields.confirm: one positive fork check per leg (Godot: structured state read; Java: one capture path)
fields.last_replayed: run dir of the last successful path replay, or null

path.shared_forks: Several items may share a path prefix; each item still carries its own exact call list and replays it independently. Never assume a client is already at the fork.

conventions.run_dir: runs/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>-<item>/ with java/, godot/, diff/, run.json, report.md; seed sweeps use runs/<stamp>-seed-<area>/ with seed/ pairs; reference soaks use runs/<stamp>-ref-<area>/ with java/ frames

compare_gate.calibration: record original gate, new numbers, reason, and frame pair in the item before changing

item_template.title: player-visible symptom or action
item_template.surface: menu | campaign | hud | world | editor | settings | database | mods | multiplayer | boot
item_template.parent: PAR-0001 or null (the fork item that revealed it)

path.to: state the item starts from

reference_soak.role: Java-only pre-load (skill §2b): record one basic in-game action per row with a reference frame and the exact calls/waits, so a later run can judge Godot against stored evidence (verified.mode=reference, skill §3b). Soaks record; they never fix or issue verdicts, and the Godot client stays down.

item_fields.reference.frames: {fork, action, ...} relative to the run dir
item_fields.reference.settle: [{after, wait_ms}] the waits that made the action land
item_fields.reference.checkpoint: save path for the next replay, or null

seeding.rule: A sweep appends every newly revealed interactive surface to frontier[] and one item per control to items[] before moving on; the next sweep pops the first frontier entry.

frontier.path: Play > Campaign > Serpulo > Ground Zero > launch
frontier.note: in-game HUD chrome: minimap, bottom icon bar, pause control (PAR-0030), Skip (PAR-0029)
